W.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Moth-er-of-pearl cloud / I hold out cold hands to catch / col-our drain-ing off); human gesture of catching fading iridescence gives a real turn, though nacreous is only evoked via mother-of-pearl.

X.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Na-cre-ous glow burns / in the long dark be-fore dawn / moth-er-of-pearl sky); accurate to polar stratospheric clouds glowing before dawn but descriptive with no turn and stock mother-of-pearl.

Y.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Af-ter the storm waves / a sky I did not ask for / held out in both hands); lovely gesture but waves and storm only vaguely suggest undulatus, barely about rare clouds.

Z.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Moth-er-of-pearl sheets / na-cre-ous light on cold air / dawn the sky holds brief); accurate but abstract, repeats the stock mother-of-pearl, and the last line is clumsy.
